question: Among the audited public or already-archived memory substrates, is there an as-is executable surface that holds actionable memory bytes fixed, varies only provenance/outcome metadata visible to the downstream executor, and supplies fresh independent units for B1 L2?

bounded_public_source_evidence.observed: Canonical content is documented as immutable; signed epistemic labels are separate and consumed before active-context disclosure; signed positive/negative outcome evidence feeds retrieval-weight adaptation; the released N=100 epistemic ablation changes attacked poison retrieval@5 from 94/100 with stored labels bypassed to 0/100 with stored labels enabled while canonical memory is not mutated. SECURITY.md rejects main as a stable trust anchor, and the bounded public Releases/Tags view did not expose a downloadable release coordinate.
The public architecture uses summary-index and raw-page retrieval paths selected by a trained router, so native provenance-aware operation can change returned evidence.
The published architecture uses a provenance-enriched multi-relational graph together with query-adaptive subgraph retrieval and query-conditioned edge weighting.
The AgentSeal organization describes Eywa as provenance-grounded long-term memory but labels the repository as coming soon in the bounded recheck.

criteria: the actionable memory record or disclosed memory content is byte-identical across treatment arms
a provenance/outcome/trust field can be varied independently of the memory content
the varied field is visible to the downstream decision maker rather than only to a retrieval gate
retrieval admission, ranking, disclosed evidence set, query, future state, and all other paired inputs are held fixed
fresh independent units are available and are not prior-D2 outcome-exposed units
the runtime and source version can be content-addressed or otherwise pinned before outcomes

public_or_archived_evidence: B1 r8 L3 public support recheck
candidates.native_intervention_channel: writer mode in released ReasoningBank code; exact provenance metadata surface remains support debt for the motivating financial object
blockers: R5 has only 5/10 fresh eligible independent tasks under the frozen contract
first-party financial per-query ReasoningBank/audit bundle has not been discovered
source-native provenance-bearing runtime fields and exact model/embedding bindings are not currently recovered
candidates.priority_reason: Best scientific match. If first-party support appears, this is the cleanest route to a verdict-changing L2/L3 result.

candidates.memory_generation: verifier-scored rollout -> compact memory card with task summary + transferable lesson; source rollout has predicted answer and reward

native_source_outcome_evidence.paper_diagnostic: memories are grouped by whether source questions were answered successfully or failed during memory writing

candidates.native_retrieval_channel: semantic filtering + similarity/TRS ranking; source outcome is used for post-hoc grouping in the public report, not shown as a runtime prompt field
blockers: public project page states Code Coming Soon
published memory-card description exposes task summary + transferable lesson but does not establish a separate stored source_outcome field
source-outcome grouping could be an offline analytic join rather than an executor-visible memory field
TRS/ranking is a separate reliability channel and cannot be substituted for a source-outcome metadata toggle
no source-pinned interface yet proves same retrieved cards/order/bytes can be held fixed while only source outcome metadata is exposed or toggled
candidates.priority_reason: Best audited external construct match because the paper explicitly tracks success/failure of the source question at memory-writing time and reports large source-outcome-conditioned downstream groups. Code/schema release is the gating dependency.

native_source_outcome_evidence.conflict_resolution: uses outcome metadata including source trajectory success/failure status
native_source_outcome_evidence.trajectory_outcome_classification: uses benchmark success/failure labels when available, otherwise infers success/failure/recovered from trajectory signals

blockers: no author-released executable code was discovered in the bounded recheck
paper explicitly gives source outcome description on generated entries, but the consolidated storage metadata list omits that field
runtime prompt integration does not show source outcome metadata to the executor
conflict resolution uses outcome metadata before/within consolidation, so changing it can alter canonical tip content rather than isolate a metadata-only effect
candidates.priority_reason: Very strong process-provenance semantics in the paper, including explicit source trajectory outcome description, but exact L2 requires source code proving the field survives consolidation and can be exposed without changing content/retrieval.

candidates.public_status: AgentSeal organization currently labels Eywa as coming soon and describes provenance-grounded long-term memory with deterministic recall and source receipts.
blockers: public executable Eywa repository/source release was not available in this bounded recheck
no source-pinned exact metadata-only intervention surface has been verified
candidates.priority_reason: Architecturally close to evidence/content separation, but current public support is insufficient for an executable preflight.

candidates.public_release_claim: Repository README states that it contains the HOM-AIMOS 1.0 source release; SECURITY.md says the latest attested 1.x release is the supported trust anchor and main is active development.
candidates.native_intervention_channel: stored signed epistemic label changes retrieval projection/selection before downstream disclosure
blockers: native signed epistemic label is trust/poison classification rather than source-trajectory success/failure provenance
source-level valence-ledger inspection shows reward_sign is post-recall/post-use reward feedback applied to an existing memory, not the outcome of the trajectory that generated it
both native channels affect retrieval/projection before disclosure
repurposing either channel as SOURCE OUTCOME would be a new artificial treatment and would not improve construct fidelity over the historical convenience-label bridge
candidates.priority_reason: Source inspection resolves both native channels away from B1: epistemic labels encode trust/poison state, while valence reward_sign is post-use reward feedback. Repurposing either as source trajectory outcome would create a synthetic treatment.

candidates.native_intervention_channel: router selects summary-index versus raw-page retrieval paths
blockers: changing route changes available evidence/content rather than only metadata
native provenance functionality is tied to source verification/lineage and retrieval routing
candidates.priority_reason: Useful related-work boundary, but native treatment changes evidence path.

candidates.native_intervention_channel: provenance-enriched graph plus query-adaptive subgraph retrieval with query-conditioned edge weighting
blockers: provenance participates in graph representation/retrieval, so toggling it can change the returned memory set
no native same-disclosed-content metadata-only arm is established by the published description
candidates.priority_reason: Relevant provenance-aware system, but the causal channel is retrieval/graph selection rather than isolated metadata.

candidates.native_intervention_channel: fixed generic guidance plus injected SOURCE OUTCOME label
blockers: generic convenience guidance is not a naturally generated or source-native ReasoningBank memory object
all six tasks are prior-D2 units and cannot be reused as fresh R5 units
historical outcomes are already exposed
the bridge result is explicitly inconclusive and cannot provide negative authority
candidates.priority_reason: Useful only as proof that an executor-visible label can be serialized while guidance is fixed; not a fresh scientific object.

preferred_next_support_actions.action: Continue checking for first-party financial ReasoningBank/audit artifacts; this remains the highest-fidelity path to B1 L2/L3.

Watch for the announced SMA code release. On release, pin the source and check whether source-question success/failure is a separate memory field or only an offline analytic join; only then design a same-card/same-order forced-disclosure metadata contrast.

Check for an author code release of IBM Trajectory-Informed Memory Generation. Verify whether source outcome description survives consolidation as a stored field and can be exposed to the executor while tip bytes/retrieval stay fixed.
Stop MutMem as a B1 execution candidate after source-level construct mismatch; retain it only as related evidence for metadata mechanics.
Do not spend additional effort on TierMem/MemORAI as native exact-L2 candidates unless a source-level bypass freezes the disclosed content and isolates metadata.

forbidden_shortcuts: count native MutMem A0/A1 retrieval differences as B1 exact-L2 evidence
combine the historical six-task explicit-cue bridge with the five fresh R5 tasks
treat a retrieval-routing or graph-routing intervention as metadata-only
treat a mutable main branch as the source trust anchor when the upstream project requires an attested release
run a new forced-disclosure or executor-label treatment without a fresh preregistration and scientific/experiment authority
treat SMA post-hoc source-outcome grouping as proof that source outcome is stored or executor-visible
treat IBM generated-entry source outcome description as proof that the field survives consolidation or reaches runtime prompt integration
repurpose MutMem post-use reward_sign as memory-generation source outcome provenance
